Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. NLC Tamilnadu Power Limited Account No. 31037748056 IFSC Code SBIN0003143 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address SPIC NAGAR, TUTICORIN . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. DD should be made in favour of NLC Tamilnadu Power Limited payable at Tuticorin . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Payment online through RTGS / internet banking also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). On-line payment shall be in Beneficiary name NLC Tamilnadu Power Limited Account No. 31037748056 IFSC Code SBIN0003143 Bank Name State Bank of India Branch address SPIC NAGAR, TUTICORIN . Successful Bidder to indicate Contract number and name of Seller entity in the transaction details field at the time of on-line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer in place of PBG within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK & SPECIAL CONDITIONS Approval of Amended Factory Plan: - This scope covers obtaining approval of the amended factory plan from Tamil Nadu DISH, following the add ition of a wet limestone FGD unit, Additional Chimney, AHS Augmentation, BESS and an RO Additional des alination unit to the existing plant. Preparation, Submission, Inspection, and Approval: 1. Preparation of the revised factory plan in CAD, as per the Tamil Nadu Factories Rules, 1950, covering: • Plan • Section • Elevation • Site Plan • Topographical Plan (updated for the addition/alteration to the existing premises) 2. Obtaining the structural stability certificate

3. Preparation of necessary forms and documents, if any 4. Internal review of the compiled plan set by the CEO, NTPL, before submission 5. Offline submission of hard copies, where required by the jurisdictional offices 6. Coordination for site inspection and closing out any corrections or compliance issues raised 7. Follow-up and resubmission to DISH, Chennai HQ, if required 8. Obtaining plan approval and handing over the same to NTPL 9. Updating the factory license annexures to reflect the amended plan, if required 10. Displaying the approved plan copy at site, as required under TNFR 1950. SPECIAL CONDITIONS 1. The rate quoted shall be firm throughout the contract period inclusive of all taxes and duties. 2. The necessary Personnel Protective Equipment (PPE) required for the work shall be arranged by the con tractor. 3. The necessary gadgets required for survey, Drawing Preparation, etc… shall be arranged by the contrac tor. 4. NTPL reserves the right to enhance or reduce the number of Work Quantity as warranted by requiremen t. 5. The firm shall quote for all the work mentioned by NTPL (for arriving package cost), failing which the off er will not be considered for evaluation. 6. The firm shall quote a lump sum service charge for work including field visit charges for the firm Technic ian/Draft Engineer. 7. L1 bidder will be selected based on the lowest total cost. 8. The Technician/Draft Engineer deputed for work should have EPF number and ESI number/ insurance co vering industrial accidents and original ID card/ Aadhaar card which should be furnished to get gate pass f or entry into NTPL plant. 9. Period of work: (a) Drawing preparation: The total duration for drawing preparation is 30 days from the d ate of commencement of work. The date of commencement of work shall be 7 days from the date of issue of LOI. However, all efforts should be made to complete the work at the minimum possible time. (b) For getting approval: Approval shall be obtained within 45 days after submitting the necessary docume nts to DISH authorities. 10. Period of Contract: Six months from the Service start date. 11. Payment Terms: 90% payment of completed works will be paid after submission of drawings and gettin g approval from the DISH authorities. Remaining 10% will be paid after finalizing the contract. 12. PRC clause: Since the work involves getting approval from statuary authorities, PRC clause is not applic able. 13. Penalty: Amount of Rs 500/- per week will be deducted for the delay in preparation of drawings (Period of work - Clause (a)) in stipulated time period. 14. Adherence to the rules and regulations: The firm shall adhere to NTPL General terms and conditions wit h respect to safety and other acts, rules and regulations. 15. NTPL Scope: Coordination for during the Course of Survey, Coordination for site drawing preparation. 16. Travel, Lodging & Boarding for drafting experts shall be under bidder’s scope. Accommodation in NTPL Guest House will be arranged on chargeable basis on availability basis. 17. If any additional work required to complete the plan approval process, the same shall be carried out an d to be completed by the contractor. 8.
